content:
I learned this the hard way.

Small wins don’t look impressive.
They don’t get claps.
They don’t get attention.

But they change you.

They keep you from quitting on quiet days.
They remind you that something is working.

Most people miss them.
That’s why most people stop.

PS: Don’t ignore your small wins.
comment: Small wins are also useful feedback loops. The challenge is building systems to capture and review them, because progress often becomes visible only when tracked over time.
